title: Keep left
message: Keep left while driving in Japan.

briefing.title: Keep left
briefing.message: Drive on the left side of the road.
briefing.whyItMatters: Wrong-side errors are especially likely after turns.

comparisonMessages.PH: Switch from Philippine right-side traffic: drive on the left in Japan.

title: Intersection
message: Intersection ahead. Yield to pedestrians and check crossing traffic.

briefing.title: Intersections
briefing.message: Check pedestrians and crossing traffic before turning.
briefing.whyItMatters: Japan's left-side traffic changes turn positioning.

comparisonMessages.PH: Keep-left positioning changes how you enter and leave intersections.

title: Traffic light
message: Red light ahead. Do not turn unless a green arrow permits it.

briefing.title: Red-light turns
briefing.message: Do not turn on red unless a green arrow permits it.
briefing.whyItMatters: Turn permissions may differ from familiar practice.
briefing.exceptions: A green arrow permits movement only in its indicated direction.

comparisonMessages.PH: Do not carry over turn-on-red assumptions; wait unless a green arrow permits movement.

title: Railroad crossing
message: Railroad crossing ahead. Stop and check both directions.

briefing.title: Railroad crossings
briefing.message: Come to a complete stop and check for trains before crossing.
briefing.whyItMatters: A clear track or silent alarm does not remove the stop requirement.

comparisonMessages.PH: Japan requires a full stop and train check even when the warning alarm is silent.

title: Pedestrian crossing
message: Pedestrian crossing ahead. Stop and give way when needed.

briefing.title: Pedestrian priority
briefing.message: Stop and yield when someone is crossing or about to cross.
briefing.whyItMatters: Pedestrians have priority at crossings and intersections.

title: Stop sign
message: Stop sign ahead. Come to a complete stop.

briefing.title: Stop signs
briefing.message: Come to a complete stop and check left and right.
briefing.whyItMatters: A rolling stop does not satisfy the sign.

title: Keep right
message: Keep to the right side of the road.

briefing.title: Keep right
briefing.message: Drive on the right side of the road.
briefing.whyItMatters: Lane-side habits can carry over after turns.

comparisonMessages.JP: Switch from Japan's left-side traffic: drive on the right in the Philippines.

title: Intersection
message: Intersection ahead. Slow down and check crossing traffic.

briefing.title: Intersections
briefing.message: Slow down and check vehicles and pedestrians before proceeding.
briefing.whyItMatters: Crossing traffic may not be visible early.

comparisonMessages.JP: Right-side positioning changes how you approach and leave intersections.

title: Traffic light
message: Traffic light ahead. Follow the signal before turning.

briefing.title: Traffic signals
briefing.message: Follow signals, signs, and lane markings before turning.
briefing.whyItMatters: Turn permissions depend on the controls at that intersection.

title: Railroad crossing
message: Railroad crossing ahead. Stop and check for trains.

briefing.title: Railroad crossings
briefing.message: Slow down, obey crossing controls, and check for trains.
briefing.whyItMatters: A crossing requires an active safety check.

title: Pedestrian crossing
message: Pedestrian crossing ahead. Slow down and yield.

briefing.title: Pedestrian crossings
briefing.message: Slow down and yield to pedestrians using the crossing.
briefing.whyItMatters: Busy roadside areas can put pedestrians near traffic.

title: Stop sign
message: Stop sign ahead. Stop at the marked line.

briefing.title: Stop signs
briefing.message: Stop fully at the marked line before proceeding.
briefing.whyItMatters: Rolling through a stop can cause a collision.
